description: Get product collections and their contents, including SEO metadata. Reports: list (all collections with product counts plus seoTitle/seoDescription), products (products in a specific collection with pricing, inventory, SEO, and optional sales data). seoTitle/seoDescription correspond to Shopify's global.title_tag and global.description_tag metafields. Use for 'how many products in the sandals collection?', 'what products are in collection X?', 'which collection products sell best?', or to inspect collection/product SEO tags.

collectionTitle.description: For products: search by collection title (partial match)

endDate.description: For products: include sales data to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

startDate.description: For products: include sales data from this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: get_collections
